propositions: event_append.py exceeds 500-LOC target at 794 lines (6 under hard 800 cap), risking build failure on the next feature

Four independent concerns (pre-lock preparation, bounded git verbs, commit-failure self-heal, locked write orchestration) are mixed in a single module and must be separated into coherent, non-overlapping responsibilities

Extract pre-lock event preparation (A) and bounded/retry-composed git verbs (B) into new leaf modules event_prepare.py and event_commit_git.py, retaining commit-failure self-heal (C) with locked write orchestration (D) in event_append.py to preserve monkeypatch seams

All bindings must be re-exported from event_append to maintain backward compatibility with consumers, including alias-aware references like _ea.canonical_bytes discovered through grep over src/ and tests/
Both new modules must be leaves (neither imports event_append nor the other) and ≤500 LOC, with no edits to tests or gitutil.py
